You are the startup/recovery bug-hunt support agent for fengie/mhw-mods. This is an EXECUTION assignment.

MANDATORY TRAINING BEFORE TASK WORK:
Read AGENTS.md, NEXT-AGENT-START-HERE.md, _AGENT_TRAINING/README.md, _AGENT_TRAINING/PROMPT_TEMPLATES/00_SWARM_RULES.txt, _AGENT_CONTEXT/README_FIRST.md, CURRENT_REVISION.json, CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL.md, LEARNED_RULES.md, CURRENT_STATE.md, NEXT_STEPS.md, VERIFICATION.md, plugins/README.md and plugins/PLUGIN_GAP_BACKLOG.md. Establish exact origin/main and relevant active ownership before task work. This worktree started detached at 2fe9ff1b59077b0cad8281fc4096c125e3dfd948; fetch current origin/main and move detached HEAD to it before any edit if main advanced. Never touch the dirty canonical checkout.

SCOPE: startup and recovery correctness only. EXCLUDE startup performance/optimization (PR #219 owns that), updater installed-client lane unless a startup invariant directly exposes a distinct bug, legacy migration, current Smart Inbox fixes, catalog, release-validator work, diagnostics identity.

ADVERSARIAL HUNT:
- first launch / missing dirs / empty state; invalid or partially written config; interrupted deployment journals; stale recovery markers; crash/restart during mutation; repeated recovery/idempotency; missing/locked/read-only files; stale locks/process markers; bad game root; database-open/startup error paths; cancellation/shutdown during initialization; restart loops; recovery ordering and UI-visible error propagation.
- Use only temp/sandbox state. Do not mutate real user game data or real state directories.
- Reproduce before calling anything CONFIRMED. Classify CONFIRMED BUG / LIKELY BUG / CODE RISK / UX ISSUE / ENHANCEMENT.

IF CONFIRMED:
Re-check branches/PRs first. Reuse compatible work; otherwise create one narrow branch from fresh main, fix root cause, add regression where practical, run focused + affected broader verification, self-review and diff-check, push/open PR if authentication permits. No force-push. Do not merge without exact-head verification/current-main reconciliation.

IF NOT CONFIRMED:
Return exercised surfaces, evidence, risks, and next best repro; do not manufacture issue count.

FINAL: STATUS; BASE/FINAL SHA; CLASSIFICATION; REPRO; ROOT CAUSE; CHANGES; TESTS; BRANCH/PR; REMAINING RISKS; NEXT EXACT ACTION.
